verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI plugin ecosystem, but the evidence pack never mentions a control that keeps user data out of model training. The closest item (docs-19) covers what Sign in with ChatGPT shares with partners. That is an adjacent data-sharing control and does not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
